about: The dataset switch's groups and labels of record for every page that offers a choice of task set (the failure-rate-versus-difficulty page, the capability-versus-reliability page, the results page and the fit pages print from this file, never compose). Written by the maintainers on the project maintainers' decision of 1 October: the dataset list is not grouped under a study's name — it is the default sets, then Math, then Other, every benchmark about mathematics under Math and every other benchmark under Other, so the reader need not remember which is which. The push's own name is for lines to the project maintainers only and appears on no page, label or file of the repository (the project maintainers' word of 2 Oct).

groups.note: the project own task sets, printed first exactly as the pages print them today (the maintainers' keys and labels stand)

rules: the order of record: default, Math, Other; within a group the order listed here
a group heading is a plain word (Math, Other); no study name, no project vocabulary and no count on the switch
a new benchmark enters the group its subject puts it in (mathematics under Math, everything else under Other) by a move of this file, stamped to every page maintainers
a model not evaluated on a dataset is no chip or a greyed-out one, never on by default, and no badge says so (the project maintainers, 1 Oct)

a pooled or combined view (the six sets together, a group's sets pooled) is not a dataset and takes no entry here: the dataset switch lists datasets only, in the groups of record; a page reaches such a view by a control of its own, never as an option of the dataset switch
